name: Indiana University Indianapolis (IU Indy)
oos_note: Public university. Total Nonresident tuition & mandatory fee 2026-27 = $35,567.00 ($34,323.16 tuition + $1,243.84 combined mandatory fee) from IU 2025-27 Operating Budgets Recommended Tuition and Fee Schedule (finance.iu.edu/doc/2025-2027-tuition-and-fee-schedule-recommended.pdf, Indianapolis campus). Matches basis of in-state total resident $10,761.76 (rounded 10,760). Cross-checked against indianapolis.iu.edu cost-of-attendance page which lists non-resident tuition & mandatory fees as $35,566 (rounded) for 2026-27, excludes housing/food $14,006.
